Audit an open-core community target directory to ensure proprietary internal
scripts, vendor-specific state, credentials, and forbidden patterns are not
leaked.

  Audit current repo as community export candidate
  zqk system export-gate
  Audit specific distribution target directory
  zqk system export-gate --target=/tmp/community-export

Usage:
  zqk system export-gate [flags]

Aliases:
  export-gate, police-export, verify-export

Flags:
      --columns string                   Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string                    Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down            Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string                    Write output to file
      --prohibited-pattern stringArray   Additional prohibited path patterns to check
  -q, --quiet                            Suppress non-essential output
      --target string                    Target directory path to audit (default ".")
      --timeout duration                 Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                          Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
